name: Brandt
description: An aged vampire hunter missing part of an ear who has pursued Strefan for decades and lures him to a ruin before cutting his own throat.

timeline.summary: Strefan survives falling into Brandt's stake pit, fends off a thrown vial of blessed water and escapes.
timeline.quote: He screamed as he felt his exposed skin burn.

timeline.summary: Strefan hurls a stake and wounds Brandt, then chases him as he flees on horseback.
timeline.quote: Bloodlust rising, he rose into the air and rushed in pursuit.

timeline.summary: Brandt's horse falls at a ruin, and Brandt slashes Strefan with a hidden blade before cutting his own throat.
timeline.quote: slit his own throat from ear to ear

timeline.summary: Brandt's blood vanishes into the stones and a vibrant mansion rises around Strefan, who finds he cannot leave through the door.
timeline.quote: now walls had sprung up around him.

timeline.summary: In a flashback Strefan recalls his first encounter with Brandt decades earlier, when Brandt tore his glamer by shouting that a vampire was in the village.
timeline.quote: the young man began hollering that there was a vampire in their midst

timeline.summary: Brandt's drained body rises and moves toward Strefan, now inhabited by something else.
timeline.quote: the body lurched to its feet

relations.note: He wants to kill the vampire hunter.
relations.quote: This would be his best opportunity in years to do away with Brandt once and for all.
